		random_owned_location = {
			limit = {
				has_building_with_at_least_one_level = pirate_haven
			}
			save_scope_as = target_location
		}
		random_list = {
			25 = {
				save_scope_value_as = {
					name = char_sex
					value = yes
				}
			}
			75 = {
				save_scope_value_as = {
					name = char_sex
					value = no
				}
			}
		}
		create_character = {
			culture = scope:target_location.dominant_culture
			religion = scope:target_location.dominant_religion
			age = { 20 30 }
			birth_location = scope:target_location
			trait_category = admiral
			female = scope:char_sex
			create_in_limbo = yes
			estate = estate_type:peasants_estate
			save_scope_as = target_character
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = culture_japan.19.a
		scope:target_location = {
			add_location_modifier = { modifier = wokou_pirate_stronghold_indifferent years  = 10 mode = add_and_extend }  
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = culture_japan.19.b
		change_gold_effect = { scale = -6.00 }
		scope:target_character = {
			add_trait = trait:buccaneer
			move_country = root
		}
		scope:target_location = {
			add_location_modifier = { modifier = wokou_pirate_stronghold_friendly years  = 10 mode = add_and_extend }  
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = culture_japan.19.c
		if = {
			limit = {

			}
			add_manpower = { value = monthly_manpower multiply = -3 }
		}
		else = {
			add_stability = stability_severe_penalty
		}
		scope:target_location = {
			destroy_building = "building(building_type:pirate_haven|owner)"
		}
		kill_character = { target = scope:target_character reason = execution }
	}
